panels.modeHelp: Change the display mode without changing your account.
panels.modeDescriptionSubscription: View 5-hour and weekly quotas and local token usage
panels.modeDescriptionApi: View your API balance and observed charges
panels.switchFailed: Could not switch modes. Try again.
panels.modeNotSaved: Mode was not saved. Try again.
panels.modeSavedSubscription: Mode changed. Use the button below to view your quota.
panels.subscriptionMissing: No subscription snapshot yet. Complete a Codex request with your subscription account, then refresh.
panels.partialScan: The scan is incomplete. Only some records are shown.
panels.tokenDisclaimer: Tokens are observed on this device, not an official remaining subscription allowance. Other devices are excluded; quota percentages cannot be converted into remaining tokens.
panels.readFailed: Could not load data. Try again later.
panels.waitingQuota: Waiting for an official quota snapshot
panels.staleQuota: Snapshot is out of date. Refresh to update.
panels.quotaDisclaimer: Quota comes from official snapshots; tokens come from local records. They are tracked separately.
panels.subsetDisclaimer: Cached input and reasoning may be subsets of input and output. Do not add them twice. Records from other devices are excluded.
panels.staleBalance: Last successful result; waiting for an update
panels.balanceUnavailable: Balance is unavailable. Check the endpoint in Settings.
panels.usagePageHelp: View charges, balance alerts and daily budgets on the Usage page.
panels.resetPending: Default will be restored when saved
panels.defaultPlaceholder: Leave blank for default; enter a new value to change
panels.priceDeleteError: To delete a price, enter only the model name and leave prices blank.
panels.priceRequired: Enter a model name and complete input, cached input and output prices.
panels.priceIncomplete: Complete the prices or select Delete for this model.
panels.feedbackHelp: Changes apply when saved. Cancel or Esc discards them. Master volume applies to all events. Original uses the selected sound group; other presets are synthesized tones.
panels.storageFailed: Settings could not be saved. Check available storage.
panels.switchTimeout: The switch has not completed. Try again or check its status.
panels.noPeak: No peak or off-peak schedule applies to this API.
panels.subscriptionRecordsMissing: No subscription quota records yet. Complete a Codex request with your subscription account, then refresh.
panels.scanIncomplete: The scan is incomplete. Only some observed records are shown.
panels.insightsDisclaimer: Local observations exclude usage on other devices. Cached input and reasoning output may be subsets of input and output; do not count them twice. Official percentages cannot be converted to a fixed remaining token allowance.
panels.workshopHelp: Share your selected characters, bubble images and sounds, or import someone else's pack. This exchanges local files; it is not an online store.
panels.workshopStep1: Create a pack: import assets using Characters, Sounds or Resource manager, then choose Export local assets.
panels.workshopStep2: Use a shared pack: select a whale-workshop.json file, review the list below, then choose Import selected pack.
panels.workshopStep3: After importing, choose Reload asset lists, then select assets in the character, sound or bubble image menus. Importing does not change your active character.
panels.workshopFormat: Accepts GPT Dragon Girl workshop JSON packs up to 24 MiB, not plugin ZIPs or installers. API settings, ledgers and chats are excluded. Assets with duplicate names receive new IDs.
panels.packTooLarge: Pack exceeds 24 MiB. Reduce the assets and try again.
panels.invalidPack: Unrecognized format. Choose a valid workshop JSON file.
panels.importComplete: Import complete. Reload the lists to choose the new characters, sounds and bubble images.
panels.exportTooLarge: Export exceeds 24 MiB. Remove some assets first.
panels.cachedRate: No new quote is available. The verified cached rate is retained.
panels.rateUnavailable: Exchange rate unavailable. The current display is retained.
panels.rateNotReady: The exchange rate is not ready. The converted amount cannot be saved.
panels.conversionSupported: Display conversion supports USD and CNY
panels.rateOriginal: Exchange rate unavailable. The original display currency is retained.
panels.previousCharge: API charges during the previous turn:
panels.turnNoTokens: No token record for this turn
panels.turnLocalTokens: Observed on this device this turn: {tokens}
panels.languageHelp: Applies immediately. Currency and billing rules stay the same.
panels.settingsIntro: Uses your Codex API settings automatically. Changes are usually unnecessary.
panels.privacyHelp: Existing values are hidden. Leave fields blank to keep them, or enter new values to change them.
panels.basePlaceholder: Leave blank to use current Codex settings
panels.domainHelp: When changing domains, also specify the key environment variable for that service.
panels.keyPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the existing Codex key
panels.keyHelp: Enter a variable name, such as MY_API_KEY, not the key itself.
panels.dashboardPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the current provider
panels.billingDivisorHelp: Use 100 when billing usage is returned in cents. Follow the endpoint documentation.
panels.quotaHelp: Only for endpoints that return raw quota values.
panels.pricingHelp: Without valid model prices, the cost of a single turn cannot be confirmed; token records remain available. New account spend is shown separately and deduplicated, and may include concurrent tasks or delayed billing. Model prices are used for turn estimates, per million tokens in the currency above. Leave fields blank to keep existing prices.
panels.modelPlaceholder: Use the exact model name from Codex
panels.removePrice: Delete prices for the specified model
panels.monitorSessions: Record local token usage and task status
panels.monitorHelp: Chat content is not sent. Using a subscription? Select Codex subscription at the top of the menu to view 5-hour and weekly quotas.
